description: This file defines the code-behind logic for the EditExam page in an ASP.NET WebForms application. It contains event handler methods for button clicks that perform server-side page transfers to various administrative pages within an online examination system.

classes.name: EditExam
classes.description: Partial class for handling server-side events of the EditExam ASP.NET page.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event; currently an empty method.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for the 'Home' button; transfers to the AdminPanel page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for the 'Profile' button; transfers to the AdminQueue page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for the 'Leaderboard' button; transfers to the AdminLeaderboard page.

methods.name: eTheoryB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for editing theoretical questions; transfers to the EditTheory page.

methods.name: eMcqB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for editing MCQ questions; transfers to the EditMCQ page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for logout button; transfers to the LoginPage.
